--- create_search_index_partition_by_interleave_column_last.sql
-- a column named interleave as the last PARTITION BY key, no INTERLEAVE IN clause
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId, interleave
OPTIONS (sort_order_sharding = true)

          ValuePos: 209,
          Value:    true,
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId, interleave OPTIONS (sort_order_sharding = true)
